subject: general
question: Anu is four times as good as Binni in doing a work. Together they finish the same work in 12 hrs. In how many hrs will Anu alone finish the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Anu is four times as good as Binni in doing a work.

Together they finish the same work in 12 hrs.

**Formula Used:**

Work Rate = 1 / Time

If Anu's work rate is 4x, then Binni's work rate is x.

Together Work Rate = (Anu's Work Rate + Binni's Work Rate)

Time taken by Anu alone to finish the work = 1 / Anu's Work Rate

**Calculation:**

Let Binni's work rate be x.

Anu's work rate = 4x

Together work rate = 4x + x = 5x

Given: Together they finish the work in 12 hrs, so their combined work rate is 1/12.

⇒ 5x = 1 / 12

⇒ x = 1 / (12 × 5)

⇒ x = 1 / 60

Anu's work rate = 4x = 4 / 60 = 1 / 15

Time taken by Anu alone to finish the work = 1 / (1 / 
15)

⇒ Time taken by Anu = 15 hrs

**Anu alone will finish the work in 15 hrs.**
